_about: HELD-OUT evaluation questions, written 2026-10-11 BEFORE the retrieval layer existed, using only the manual's file listing (no page content) to choose gold pages. Gold labels are the author's judgement and have not been checked by a second person. Used once for the reported baseline numbers; do not tune rules against these. Classes: answer_local = answerable from the local index/catalog with no model or network; outside_index = the manual documents it but it is outside the local index (a targeted official-doc fetch or a model would be needed); find_tutorial = needs tutorial discovery (external search or a curated index); import_tutorial = turning a given tutorial into steps (transcript or video model); ask_state = depends on the user's current application state, ask or inspect; clarify = too vague; decline = not answerable from Blender documentation.
